sloka: अद्यार्य मुदिता: सन्तु सुहृदस्ते ऽभिषेचने ।अद्य भीता: पलायन्तां दुर्हृदस्ते दिशो दश ॥ २.१०६.२९॥
transliteration: adyārya muditā: santu suhṛdaste 'bhiṣecane ।adya bhītā: palāyantāṁ durhṛdaste diśo daśa ॥ 2.106.29॥

translations.english: O my esteemed brother let all your friends be delighted today at your enthronement and your enemies flee in terror in ten different directions.
